lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  let w : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hu : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  have h₀ : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  profile_tactic "c2" in have c2 : Y → V := fun x => f x
  profile_tactic "c1" in have c1 : Y → ℝ := fun x => B x
  profile_tactic "c3" in have c3 : Y → V := fun x => (1 : ℝ) • f x₀
  profile_tactic "c4" in have c4 : Y → V := fun x => B x • f x₀
  profile_tactic "c5" in have c5 : Y → V := fun x => B x • f x₀
  profile_tactic "c6" in have c6 : IsTestFunction fun x => B x • f x₀ := IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨c1, ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  profile_tactic "app" in have key := hg _ c6
  trivial
